name: Doornik-628F
description: Doornik-628F was the sixth planet in the Doornik-628 system, located in the Farlax sector, which was in turn a part of the Koornacht Cluster, a region of the Negs portion of the Core Worlds. The system was centered around the star Doornik-628. Doornik-628F was a gas giant and was circled by eleven moons.
